dts.quote: Clasico The most famous dive site in the Catalinas, Clasico features strong currents that attract large schools of fish, manta rays (seasonal), white-tipped reef sharks, and vibrant coral formations, making it ideal for advanced divers.

bw.quote: Clasico, Catalina Islands The renowned Clasico dive site is located on the western side of the islands

highlights.text: Fish schools, seasonal mantas, white-tip reef sharks

bw.quote: Cuatro Piedras Cuatro Piedras is an excellent dive site for beginners, with a shallow sandy patch nestled between the rocks. However, currents can sometimes make it challenging to stay in the sand patch.

hazards.text: Currents can make it hard to stay on the sand patch

bw.quote: Guacamaya Island Guacamaya Island is suitable for all diving levels, with depths ranging from 5 meters (16 feet) on the east side to nearly 30 meters (98 feet) on the west. This small island is always teeming with fish
